## Technical Writing

- [PostgreSQL Internals for Production Multi-Tenant Backends](https://signalgap9-del.github.io/writing/postgres-internals.html): MVCC & Visibility Map bloat, SSI serialization anomalies (SQLSTATE 40001), SKIP LOCKED queues, EXPLAIN BUFFERS, and RLS planner pitfalls.
- [Production AI Agent Architecture: Reliability, pass^k Evals & Failure Modes](https://signalgap9-del.github.io/writing/agent-architecture-evals.html): Open-source agent runtime anatomy, 5-layer systems reliability, Inspect AI pass^k evaluation, UK Gov Redbox/Lex lessons, and harness failure modes.
- [Architecting a Real-Time Multimodal AI Agent SaaS on Cloudflare Edge](https://signalgap9-del.github.io/writing/multimodal-agent-architecture.html): Durable Object session leases, split-agent loops, AI Gateway routing, micro-USD atomic credit ledgers, and OpenMeter + BigQuery metering.
- [Running LLM Inference on Customer GPUs (vLLM & SGLang)](https://signalgap9-del.github.io/writing/onprem-llm.html): PagedAttention vs RadixAttention, AWQ/FP8 quantization, guided JSON decoding, and prefix caching for enterprise RAG.
- [GraphRAG for E-Commerce: Why Product Catalogs Break Naive RAG](https://signalgap9-del.github.io/writing/graphrag-ecommerce.html): Hybrid BM25 + knowledge-graph expansion for SKU compatibility and relational queries.
- [Per-Tenant RAG Isolation in Multi-Tenant AI SaaS](https://signalgap9-del.github.io/writing/tenant-rag.html): Silo vs pool vector stores, server-enforced metadata filters, quota math, and GDPR deletion.
- [Building an Operating System for Autonomous AI Coding Agents](https://signalgap9-del.github.io/writing/agents.html): Lifecycle hooks, deterministic exec/file guards, action ledgers, and typed review gates in devin-harness.
- [On-Prem AI Is a Services Business](https://signalgap9-del.github.io/writing/onprem-ai-services.html): Operational realities of enterprise self-hosted LLM deployments.
- [Building a Real-Time Freight Risk Intelligence SaaS](https://signalgap9-del.github.io/writing/freightscaler.html): AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, OR-Tools route optimization, multi-tenant quotas, idempotency, and 24 ADRs.
- [The Production AI Open-Source Stack](https://signalgap9-del.github.io/writing/oss-stack.html): SGLang, vLLM, Langfuse, LangGraph, MCP, Qdrant, pgvector, Ragas, and LiteLLM in production.
